step_behavior: The parent records the actual child exit, both file hashes, sampled memory, CPU and OOM data, then raises and collects original diagnostic lines and trace-qualified counts. Wrapper saves driver.exit, serial receipt reference/hash, conditionally full serial frames, sync, poweroff.
natural_vs_cancelled: Exit 143 denotes an operator interruption after the genuine errors already logged. Do not reclassify as natural code-1 completion or success. Stopping the outer service can skip these finalizers.
retention: Raw logs and objects stay on retained EBS; work without successful .trace excluded. Failed run does not generate successful-build object hash manifest. New attempt uses a fresh project build.
deadline: Keep original AWS Scheduler stop, boot timer, transient unit properties and automatic poweroff unchanged.
actual_mount_validation: Use unique checked unit ancestry, exact configured Lake argv, mount/dev-inode identity for /proc/PID/root/project vs audited attempt source, exact source/tree, and real flushed source error. Never infer identity from process name alone.
local_test_limitation: stock Linux Lean 4.35 and Ubuntu bubblewrap 0.9; Bash timing wrapper substituted for production GNU time; disposable fixture, no AWS
